title: Josiah Celebrates the Passover
description: King Josiah organizes a large-scale Passover celebration in Jerusalem during his eighteenth year of reign. He assigns the priests to their duties and instructs the Levites to slaughter the Passover lamb and carry out the sacrifices according to the Lord's command given through Moses. Josiah and the leaders provide abundant sheep and cattle for the people, and the service is conducted according to the regulations of David and Solomon. It is recorded that no such Passover had been celebrated in Israel since the days of the prophet Samuel.
